skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and retaining the denominator.

skills.name: Convert unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator or LCD for unlike denominators and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Operate with mixed or whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole-number operands into whole and fractional parts, use implicit zero parts when needed, subtract whole parts, and recombine the final whole and fractional components.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup by reducing the whole-number part and adding one or more denominator-over-denominator units to the fractional minuend when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize the result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or normalize a zero fractional part into an appropriate integer or zero result.
